headline: Plan Your Lake Geneva Cruise and Vineyard Visit
reservation: While the lake and terraces are publicly accessible, specific boat cruises or guided vineyard tours may require advance booking. Check official transport and tourism sites for the most current ticketing systems and availability as seasonal schedules vary.

days.title: Lakeside Charm and Lavaux Terraces

stops.name: Geneva
stops.detail: Experience the unique charm of the lake with a scenic cruise or a stroll through the UNESCO-listed vineyard terraces of Lavaux.

days.driving: Allow for local train or boat transfers; conditions and schedules vary.
